title: 4 FIRs over INDIA bloc march; takedown request for 500 pieces of content
content: Delhi Police have filed four FIRs regarding protests linked to the INDIA bloc and associated violations. These cases involve barricade violations and road defacement, according to police sources. Additionally, four FIRs pertain to disinformation initiatives believed to be linked to social media accounts based in Pakistan. Investigators are focusing on over 100 suspicious social media handles aiming to spread anti-India narratives.

title: Man held for sexually assaulting minor at temple near Pune, CCTV footage emerges
content: In a harrowing incident, a daily-wage worker was arrested for the sexual assault of a minor girl at a temple. The incident unfolded on Sunday during the girl's visit with her parents. Thanks to CCTV footage, the police swiftly identified and apprehended the suspect. He now faces charges under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the POCSO Act, while authorities work diligently to ensure justice for the victim.

title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi drops two-word message ahead of India vs West Indies 4th T20I
content: India will look to seal the five-match T20I series when they face the West Indies in the fourth match at the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad on Wednesday. With India leading the series 2-1, the possibility of 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi getting a chance has once again become a major talking point.

title: Bittu Tabahi ‘heartbroken’ after finding garbage in river he cleaned for 8 months
content: Bittu Tabahi's return to the Ajnar River after an eight-month cleanup revealed a heartbreaking reality; the river was heavily polluted again. In a poignant video, he shared his frustration and vowed to keep documenting the situation. Previously, he successfully removed large quantities of waste from the Yamuna and surrounding areas, yet the formidable challenge of sustaining these clean-ups amid persistent pollution persists.

title: US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires
content: In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security has abolished the 540-day automatic extension for work permits. This development results in immediate loss of work authorization for many, particularly affecting H-4 visa holders and asylum seekers, even while their renewal applications are pending. Moreover, the USCIS continues to face notable delays in processing these renewals, leading to a legal challenge from impacted parties contesting the new regulation.

title: CJP’s Das, Ranka sent to Tihar Jail for 5 days over Jantar Mantar trespass
content: Cockroach Janata Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested for violating protest-related regulations. They allegedly breached barricades and entered a protest site designated for demonstrations. Their arrests are a response to ongoing protests against alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. The Delhi Police recently designated new protest venues, moving demonstrations away from the political center. The CJP criticized this move, claiming it weakens public dissent visibility.

title: Taxman adds Rs 55.2 lakh over joint Rs 80 lakh property; ITAT grants relief
content: A man bought a residential property jointly with his wife and his father. The Income Tax Department reopened his assessment for the 2016-17 assessment year after receiving information through its Risk Management Strategy that he had purchased an immovable property during the 2015-16 financial year. The man then approached the ITAT, challenging both the addition and the calculation underlying it.

title: New Jersey girl, 11, builds moss filter designed to remove 95% of lead from water
content: Nithya Tammana, a passionate young advocate, noticed rampant water wastage at home, prompting her to launch Save Drop. This initiative has attracted over 450 young changemakers dedicated to preserving water resources. Through impactful campaigns, she stresses the necessity of altering daily water conservation habits. Furthermore, she developed BioLayer, a nature-inspired water filter designed to enhance water quality, earning accolades for her contributions to environmental sustainability.

title: Shreveport glass plant demolition to recycle 95% of steel, brick and concrete
content: Full-scale demolition of the former Libbey Glass plant in Shreveport is now underway and progressing. Environmental contaminants have been cleared over the 54-acre site, allowing for redevelopment opportunities. Demolition teams are set to dismantle the industrial silos that have dominated the skyline for decades. Local authorities expect increased truck traffic around Jewella Avenue until mid-2027 due to construction activities.

title: Elon Musk congratulates CEOs & execs after Google CEO announces Gemini 4 Argon
content: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced the global launch of the Gemini 4 Argon AI model for developers and businesses. This AI model is designed to handle complex tasks in various fields, including coding and finance. Elon Musk praised the effective communication method of CEOs using social media directly to share product news. The initial pricing for the AI model is set, with discounted rates available until late 2026.

title: Iowa farmer says crops barely cover taxes; solar leases offer $1,200 an acre

This initiative is set to ensure reliable income through long-term land leases amid tough farming conditions. It promises to produce a substantial amount of electricity, enough to power many local homes, while also creating jobs and boosting tax revenues.

title: 13 dead as boat capsizes in Ganga in Bihar’s Vaishali, several missing

The local community is in distress, with RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav voicing his grief and urging immediate rescue actions. The administration is actively working to hasten relief efforts and support victims, while officials keep a vigilant watch on the unfolding situation.

title: Delhi man beaten to death for spilling beer on club manager's wife
content: A 29-year-old driver named Daljeet Singh was killed after an altercation at a club in Delhi. The incident began when he accidentally spilled beer on the club manager's wife during her birthday celebration. Following a violent confrontation, Daljeet and his friends were assaulted by the club staff. After returning home, Daljeet fell ill, prompting his wife to take him to the hospital.

title: Is asking wife to wash clothes and utensils cruelty? Bombay HC explains Section 498A
content: The Bombay high court addressed a case regarding cruelty allegations under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code. The court found that asking a woman to wash clothes and utensils did not amount to cruelty. Additionally, it quashed the charges against six relatives due to vague allegations lacking specifics. The court noted that the relatives lived separately from the woman and her claims lacked detail.

title: What Chinese pilots revealed about Rafale, MiG-29 after Egypt air drills
content: In a recent collaborative military drill named Eagles of Civilization 2026, Chinese pilots participated in air combat exercises with Egyptian Rafale and MiG-29 aircraft in Egypt. The focus was on enhancing close-range manoeuvring skills and electronic warfare tactics. The J-16 fighters, supported by KJ-500 airborne early warning aircraft, displayed their strengths in simulated combat, while Egyptian pilots took special interest in the electronic jamming techniques demonstrated by the Chinese force.

title: 'My name used without permission': Dhawan to take legal action against league

In a post on X, he said his team would take appropriate legal action and urged the media and fans to ignore unauthorised announcements. Dhawan has represented India across all three international cricket formats.

title: 6 teams, Rs 25k reward: Hunt on for model Shraddha Dubey in UP bizman's death case

Police initiated a murder investigation following a complaint from Sharma’s family about his suspected assault. The live-in partner, Shraddha Dubey, along with four others, has been booked in connection to the case. Family members alleged that Sharma was held captive and tortured before his death.

title: Russia detains Japanese journalist for spying on strategic island

This development arises against a backdrop of rising tensions between Japan and Russia, especially due to the ongoing Ukraine conflict. Japan's classification as an 'unfriendly' nation complicates matters further, intensifying the diplomatic rift.

title: Iran shifts tactics, steps up ship attacks to pressure Trump before US midterms

This tactic is designed to apply economic pressure on the United States and its allies, complicating their strategies just ahead of the midterm elections. As tensions rise, the risk to multiple vessels may increase, potentially affecting energy costs for American consumers.

title: Houthis target Saudi Aramco compound, limited fire reported

Authorities reported intercepting multiple missiles and drones aimed at various regions, including Riyadh. The situation remains tense as Saudi Arabia faces continued threats from Houthi forces.

For severe pain or swelling, it's crucial to consult a doctor before participating to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience.

title: India reaffirms Ladakh status as China says it doesn’t recognise the UT
content: new Delhi reiterated no amount of Chinese denial can change established fact that the Ladakh UT is an integral and inalienable part of India . the ministry of home affairs announced the standardisation in a press release on October 2, identifying the places/ geographical features on the survey of India map was aimed at facilitating their accurate recognition .

title: 'With our tigress': Dhruv Rathee shares picture with Neha Bora after Oct 10 detention
content: Rathee and Bora shared the picture on X, showing them seated on a sofa under the portraits of BR Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi . the video was posted with the caption, “with our tigress”, referring to Bora . more than 30,000 personnel deployed, while over 7,000 people were detained across the city .

title: ‘Massive’ oil, gas exploration to begin in ‘our beautiful Greenland’: Donald Trump
content: "massive oil, gas, and mineral exploration is getting ready to begin in our new and beautiful Greenland!" Trump wrote on Truth Social . "there are experts that are saying that the amount of easily available oil is far greater than that of almost any land, anywhere in the world," he added .

title: Is Netanyahu urging Trump to strike Iran before US, Israel polls?
content: the discussions took place last week, before Trump said he would not strike Iran ahead of the US midterm elections . a report says Netanyahu had held several calls with Trump over the past two weeks about resuming major combat operations against Iran . an official cited in the report said Netanyahu told Trump he was concerned about Israeli intelligence suggesting that Iran was taking troubling steps to reconstitute its nuclear programme .

title: 'They didn't wake me up': Netanyahu says security chiefs mistook Oct 7 attack for drill
content: security chiefs feared waking him before the attack on the night of October 7, 2023 . he claims intelligence and military chiefs believed he could trigger a attack . the prime minister blamed security establishment for failing to anticipate the assault . "if we wake up the pm, he’ll cause Hamas to attack us without meaning to," he says .

title: 'Jantar Mantar belongs to people, will reclaim it': Rahul, Kejriwal slam CJP leaders' arrest
content: 'Jailing youth for it is an act of cowardice,' Rahul Gandhi says . "we will reclaim it," he says in a post on X . he also criticizes the arrest, questioning the detention of the CJP leaders .

title: 'Makes such claims all the time’: BJP dismisses TMC’s Mamata knife attack allegation
content: BJP dismisses claims that a woman attempted to attack former chief minister Mamata Banerjee with a knife outside her residence . the BJP dismissed the allegations, with west Bengal minister dilip Ghosh questioning her claims of being attacked . he questioned how a leader with Z+ security cover could face such a threat .
